AdvancedSearchRequest.description: provider_options.kind must equal the selected non-common profile. Common profile rejects provider_options. No semantic downgrade.

AttachUpstreamId.description: Server independently verifies provider identity and intent correlation before attaching. Neither hold is released.

Attempt.description: Sanitized metadata only; no query, content, credentials or headers.

AuditEvent.description: Redacted audit event; reason/evidence references are bounded, with no raw credentials or research input.

BudgetWriteOff.description: Debits the full reservation as spent/uncertain without restoring allowance; does not release capacity.

CapacityOverride.description: Distinct audited risk override; retains unknown upstream state and never claims cancellation or refunds.

ConnectionInfo.description: Cookie-safe capability/profile/contract source. Examples contain placeholders only; no live token or service secret.

EstimatedBudget.description: mini requires amount >= 110; pro requires >= 250. Reservation is an estimate, never a provider-enforced cap.

ExaDeepOptions.description: Provider-pinned options. Category company/people cannot use publication filters; people cannot use exclude_domains. Runtime semantic validation rejects incompatible combinations before admission.

Hostname.description: Hostname only; no wildcard/path. Security validation additionally rejects internal/reserved names and every private DNS answer.

IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque client retry key. Scope is stable principal plus research_create, shared by REST, admin and MCP; never log its clear value.

Job.description: Stopping observation never releases unsettled slot/budget holds. completion_reason and upstream_state are open provider strings, not success indicators. Result may be null when still running or content retention expired. Reading encrypted content with unavailable master key returns secret_store_locked.

JobDetail.description: The detail endpoint accepts events_cursor/events_limit for the append-only event timeline. Job mutations return Job; detail returns JobDetail.

KeyUsage.description: finite requires a numeric limit; unlimited/unknown have null limit and remaining. Missing Exa service-key permission uses unavailable_reason=service_permission_missing, never a fabricated balance.

MapRequest.description: Same-host traversal, Tavily only. Safe regular-expression policy is checked before dispatch.

OpenApiDocument.description: The complete audited canonical OpenAPI document, served byte-equivalently as JSON.

OutputSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 object; at most 16 KiB UTF-8, nesting depth 8, 128 properties per object. Only local fragment $ref values; remote loading disabled. Reject unsupported provider schema keywords before admission.

QuotaPolicy.description: No budget configured means no upstream dispatch; currency units are never combined.

Readiness.description: Network diagnostics never relax startup checks. Nonloopback operation requires explicit TLS/reverse-proxy, authentication and trusted Origin configuration; missing requirements reject startup. Loopback mode does not require these nonloopback settings.

ReconcileRequest.description: Exactly one action per versioned request. Budget write-off and capacity override require separate acknowledgements/audit events.

RequestRecord.description: Counts and partial are null until a trustworthy result summary is known; zero means known empty, never unknown. Partial is true only for usable output with failed items or an explicit partial completion. Oversized upstream responses fail with response_too_large and preserve billing uncertainty; they do not fabricate an empty or partial success. Raw request and result content is not retained in this record.

ResearchCreate.description: Binding lookup precedes current configuration/admission. Missing optional fields use persisted original defaults during replay. Budget is always explicit; UI defaults exa_auto to a hard USD 1 cap. Superseding requires both fields and an owned prior job; never automatic.

ResearchExecutionSnapshot.description: Internal execution provenance frozen on first admission, separate from replay identity. Includes the immutable route policy and original provider/key-association/credential reference; contains no credential or raw input. Replay never replaces it with current routing.

ResearchReplayContext.description: Internal persistence contract, never returned by an endpoint. Freeze atomically with the binding and keep for its full lifetime. Replay uses this context before consulting current config; missing or unreadable context fails closed. Route revision is separate execution provenance and is excluded from the intent digest.

ResearchReplayDefaults.description: Only omitted optional intent fields may use these original defaults. Required input and budget are never restored from prior intent. Defaults are captured even when the original request supplies an explicit value.

Retention.description: Unresolved jobs/credentials/holds/bindings are never expired by ordinary retention.

RoutePolicy.description: allow_duplicate_cost applies only to synchronous operations. It never changes research creation uncertainty behavior.

RoutePreviewRequest.description: Local validation and routing only: no reservation, key validation or upstream request.

RouteReplace.description: All six operation policies are seeded at revision 1. Policies are disabled or replaced, never deleted. The first update uses the seeded revision.

expected_version.description: Must equal the current RoutePolicy.revision; stale revisions return 409 revision_conflict.

Session.description: CSRF token delivered in the response body, held in memory; never store bearer/session credentials in browser storage. Session refresh preserves principal identity.

SessionCreate.description: Login needs an exact allowed Origin and a local operator credential; no pre-session CSRF token exists. Rate-limited. A wrong credential returns 401 invalid_token; a missing or expired existing session returns 401 authentication_required.

Settings.description: Cookie-safe local readiness feeds Overview. Protected network/bind/data/master-key settings are diagnostics only, never patchable here.

SettleTerminal.description: Requires independent verification of termination. Only a reported cost settles budget; null retains financial hold.

TokenCreate.description: Server derives stable owner principal from the admin session. Caller cannot nominate another owner or grant admin scopes.

token_value.description: One-time reveal only. Never returned by list/read, never logged or persisted in browser storage.

UpstreamKey.description: An independently managed upstream key. association_ref is immutable accounting metadata, never an account resource. Unknown common identity does not block configured local safety limits. shared_limit is an additional constraint for reliably linked keys; it is not an independent allocation.
